text:
Diego R.: Hi folks 44b Starting today on Orders team. Need access to Grafana (orders-dashboard), Datadog (service:orders) and Sentry project 'orders-prod'. Email diego.r@redwood.ai. Also can't find the alerts for checkout.success-rate in Datadog. Who do I ping?
Jules (DevEx): Welcome Diego! :wave: Usual flow: Okta groups -> observability-viewers gets you view access to Grafana/Datadog. Sentry project invites are manual. If you don't see the groups file an identity request at https://go.redwood/identity-requests with scopes: grafana:viewer, datadog:standard, sentry:member. Paste the ID here and we'll fast-track.
Diego R.: Okta shows only base groups, not observability-viewers. Filed REQ-209334 with reason: ramping on orders and triage for first-week.
okta-bot: Request REQ-209334 received. Next step: manager approval required. Approve at https://idp.redwood/requests/209334.
Nina (Platform): Diego 44b Which org namespace? orders live in ap-southeast currently. We have separate Grafana folders for apac. Give me your org id and I'll check folder permissions.
Diego R.: Org: redwood-apac-orders.
infra-bot: Datadog invite queued for diego.r@redwood.ai (expires in 48h). Invite ref: 1831237890-INV.
Raf (Ops): Quick note: checkout.success-rate is a composite SLO in Datadog, tag=service:orders,env:prod. If you don't see it check SLO filters (owner=ops or team=orders). Also we keep the alert runbook at https://runbooks.redwood/orders/checkout-success and the playbook for post-failure steps.
Diego R.: Manager approved the identity request.
okta-bot: Identity REQ-209334 status: approved. Provisioning will start.
security-bot: Reminder: APAC access requires MFA + device attestation. Please enroll Okta Verify and confirm device in https://idp.redwood/devices.
Diego R.: Enrolled MFA and device approved.
Jules (DevEx): Sentry invite sent 44e Check spam if missing. Grafana: I can add you to the orders folder now. Which dashboard slugs do you need?
Diego R.: orders-dashboard and reconciler-metrics. Also want to annotate a deploy at 15:30 SGT later today. Prefer temporary edit perms for annotations only.
Nina (Platform): Added Diego as folder viewer for /team/orders and granted annotation role for 1 hour starting at 2024-07-10T15:25:00+08:00. You can post annotations via the API or UI.
Diego R.: Able to view both dashboards. Sentry invite received and release-health visible. Datadog SLOs still not showing the composite one though 914
Raf (Ops): Give it a minute while the Datadog account finishes provisioning. If it's still missing in 10m ping me and I'll re-index. Meanwhile you can query the SLO via API: 
```
curl -H "DD-API-KEY: $DD_API_KEY" "https://api.datadoghq.com/api/v1/slo?query=service:orders"
```
Diego R.: That returned the SLO, so good. Thanks.
Jules (DevEx): Nice. Quick tips: 1) playlists in Grafana are handy for handoffs (we have /playlists/orders-oncall). 2) If you need to annotate multiple panels use the annotations API. 3) For long-term edit access submit a role change request.
Diego R.: Perfect. Can someone DM me where the onboarding walkthrough deck lives?
Jules (DevEx): Sent deck link via DM and scheduled a 15m walkthrough at 16:00 SGT.
Diego R.: Awesome, appreciate the speedy help :rocket:
Jules (DevEx): Welcome again! Ping here if anything gaps in the setup.
